title: Kudinsa, farashi, sayar da shi da gaskiya, gama aikinku

say: Cika shi, farashi, sayar da shi da gaskiya, kuma gama aikin ku.
Wannan bidiyon ne don samfura na 4 na Kula da Fata da Gashi.
Yawancin masu yi suna farashi ta hanyar kallon abin da wasu ke caji. Idan ba ku san farashin ku ba, kuna iya siyar da kowace tulu a asara ba tare da lura ba.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
panel.heading: Ku san farashin ku kafin farashin ku
items: Kwafi farashin wasu na iya ɓoye hasara
Saƙonnin gaskiya suna kawo masu siye mai maimaitawa
Dutsen dutsen ku: samfurin gashi ɗaya da aka gwada

say: Gaskiya, ƙayyadaddun bayanai suna gina amana wanda ke kawo masu siye mai maimaitawa.

say: Kemi tana yin 500 g na lavender bulala, kwalba biyar kamar 100 g.
Kayan nata ya kai kimanin naira 8,450. Man lavender kawai shine 6,000 na wancan.
Kunshin Naira 2,500 ne.
Kusan sama da 800 ne, kuma awanni 2 na aiki a naira 1,000 a sa’a 2,000 ne.
Cikakkun kason naira 13,750. An raba shi da kwalba 5, wato Naira 2,750 a kowace kwalba, kafin riba.
Ninka cikakken farashin naúrar da alamar. A sau 1.8, farashin Kemi ya kai kusan naira 4,950, inda ta kai dubu biyar.

say: Sannan ba da hujja daga masu gwajin ku. Masu gwaje-gwaje shida sun yi amfani da shi sau biyu a mako har tsawon makonni hudu, kuma yawancin sun sami haske.
Yi alƙawarin laushi, haske da danshi, ba zai taɓa warkewa ko tabbacin girma ba. Hoto a cikin hasken rana tare da alamar za a iya karantawa, kuma bayyana farashin a sarari.

say: Dutsen dutsen ku samfurin gashi ɗaya ne. Esther a Jos ta yi wani man da ba a kamshi ba, ta gwada shi da mata shida masu nau'in gashi iri-iri na tsawon makonni hudu, sannan ta rage kasko daga kashi 40% zuwa 35%.
Duba babban fayil ɗin ku yana da kowane abu a nan. Rike maƙasudin kwanaki 90 ƙanana da gaske. Zai fi kyau a tsara tallace-tallace 20 kuma ku cim ma 25 fiye da tsara 500 kuma ku daina.

items: Formula a cikin kaso, gram da dalilai
Dilution a cikin kewayon, ko rashin kamshi
Gwajin fata da shaidar gwaji mai amfani
Batch rikodin da takardar farashi
Alamar gaskiya, babu da'awar likita
Tsarin kwanaki 90 tare da kwanan wata da ma'auni

say: Don tunawa. Ƙididdige duk farashin farashi guda huɗu, farashi daga farashin ku, kuma kada ku taɓa rangwame ƙasa da shi. Bayyana samfurori a cikin sassa biyar na gaskiya.
Sannan satifiket dinka ba rajistar NAFDAC bane. Yi amfani da binciken Module 3 don tsara wannan matakin.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Sinadaran, marufi, aiki, sama-sama
Farashin daga farashi, sannan duba kasuwa
Kar a taɓa rangwame ƙasa da cikakken farashi
Menene, sinadaran, wane, ta yaya, hujja
Takardar shaidar ba rajistar NAFDAC ba ce

say: Juyin ku. Farashin samfur ɗaya kuma saita farashin dillalan ku da na jimla. Rubuta jeri mai kashi biyar tare da hotuna guda uku, kuma adana amsa mai kyau don amsawa. Sa'an nan kuma haɗa babban fayil ɗin babban dutsen ku kuma yi alama akan jerin abubuwan dubawa.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Farashin daya samfur; saita kiri da wholesale
